topic: Stye: warm compress, don't squeeze, see a doctor if it spreads

youtube.title: Stye on your eyelid? Don't squeeze it! 🚫 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Painful bump on your eyelid? Do this, not that.
இமையில் கட்டி? அழுத்தி பிழியாதீர்கள்!

• A stye is a blocked, infected oil gland near the lash line.
• Do: clean warm compress on the closed eye, about 10 minutes, 3–4 times a day.
• Do: wash hands before touching your eyes; keep the eyelid gently clean.
• Don't: squeeze or pop it, as it can push the infection deeper and spread it.
• Don't: wear eye makeup or contact lenses until it heals; replace old eye makeup.
• See a doctor if swelling spreads to the eyelid or cheek, the eye swells shut, vision changes, or it isn't better in about a week.
• Most styes settle in about a week. General education only.

gmb.text:
Stye care: do's and don'ts. A stye is a small blocked and infected oil gland near the eyelashes. Most settle in about a week.

Do: hold a clean warm compress on the closed eye for about 10 minutes, 3–4 times a day, and wash your hands before touching your eyes.
Don't: squeeze or pop it, and avoid eye makeup and contact lenses until it heals.

See a doctor if the swelling spreads across the eyelid or cheek, the eye swells shut, your vision changes, or it isn't better in about a week. Getting styes again and again? An eye test can check for eye strain. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
